reason: I'll join the gut sections first: the small intestine ends beside the colon outline, so their connection is clear.
expectation: I expect a continuous digestive tract with the colon attached to the upper gut.

alternatives.reason: The repaired skin also has a clearly matching opening, but I want to finish the gut first.

effect: The gut is now a continuous tube, with absorbed materials crossing its lining into blood.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the two sections connect as expected.
reason: I'll fit the repaired skin into the matching opening from the wound chapter.
expectation: I expect the scarred segment to sit in its original place on the skin covering.

alternatives.reason: The eye also belongs in the head, but the skin opening is especially clear.

effect: The repaired segment now fills its original opening and connects to neighboring vessels and nerves.
reaction: It is satisfying that the small scar remains visible rather than becoming the whole skin covering.
reason: I'll place the eye in the head; its optic nerve was already shown leading toward the brain.
expectation: I expect the eye to fit into the head with its optic nerve connected toward the brain.

alternatives.reason: The ears also belong in the head, but I'll place the eye first.

effect: The eye is in the skull, with its optic nerve leading to the brain; the other eye was supplied.
reaction: The connection to the earlier eye model is clear.
reason: I'll add the ears to finish the head. It's the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the ears to fit on the head with their hearing and balance nerves leading toward the brain.

effect: The ears are in place, with hearing and balance nerves leading to the brain, and the chapter is complete.
reaction: The result matched what I expected and kept the earlier ear parts together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the repaired skin was most worthwhile: the small scar stayed in its original place, and its vessels and nerves connected to the surrounding skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the ears felt least engaging because it was the only offered combination and the result was predictable.

surprise.text: I noticed that a second eye was supplied rather than built separately; the one I fitted occupied one orbit.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The gut, skin and head pieces all had clear matching places.

continue.text: I might continue if another chapter introduced a new body process, but this chapter mostly assembled familiar pieces, so the hook to keep going is modest.
